title: RepoConfig
description: Per-repository factory configuration at factory/repo.yaml. Human-authored, Tier 3 (agent-control) path. Decides how the line finishes a bean in THIS repo: who merges, what happens after merge, how many beans may be in flight.

merge_mode.description: human_required: the line only opens PRs. auto_when_unlocked: the controller merges tiers that have met the numeric unlock (§06). auto: solo-developer opt-in — the controller merges Tier 0-2 once CI is green and the pre-PR verdict is accept; Tier 3 is never autonomous in any mode.

merge_mode_signoff.description: Required when merge_mode is 'auto'. Records the human who accepted that no second reviewer exists.

required_checks.description: GitHub check names that must be green for the exact candidate_sha before any merge.

post_merge.description: Actions the controller runs after merged, in order. Failure -> deploy_failed, alert, never rolled back automatically.

workflow.description: GitHub Actions workflow file name for kind=workflow_dispatch.

run.description: argv array for kind=command, run by the controller (not the worker).

max_inflight.description: Concurrent beans (one git worktree each). Inference is still serialized by the inference manager.

policy_ref.description: Path to the risk-policy YAML, e.g. factory/risk-policy.yaml

gates_ref.description: Path to the gate manifest, e.g. factory/gates.lock.yaml

spec_template.description: HTML template the controller renders the spec into. Default: factory/templates/spec.html

impl_template.description: HTML template for the implementation-detail document. Default: factory/templates/impl-detail.html

audience_note.description: Who reads these documents. Injected into the writer prompt so no stack knowledge is assumed.
